direct_label_control.verdict: A falsifiable low-cost diagnostic, NOT a generally valid semantic reduction. Conditionally defensible only on a preregistered restricted domain of explicit, unconditional, single-field monotone preference statements with exactly three allowed meanings.
semantic_hazards: An imperative/question such as Which option is cheaper? does not literally assert what a criterion prefers; interpreting it as a statement is an unvalidated pragmatic conversion.
This criterion has a deictic/metalinguistic referent not explicitly established by raw q.
Contradiction of prefers higher need not imply prefers lower: prefer equality/middle range, ignore field, avoid extremes, threshold, or conditional preferences are additional possibilities.
NLI neutral means neither entailment nor contradiction/insufficient evidence; it is not equivalent to unrelated field.
Compositions and conditional criteria can support conflicting directions, cancellation, or non-monotone preference; one NLI label cannot represent all semantics.
Negated preference does not logically establish the opposite preference without an explicit exhaustiveness assumption.
implementation_requirements_for_parent: Use model config ID labels, not fixed universal positions. cross-encoder DeBERTa uses0contradiction/1entailment/2neutral; ModernBERT/mmBERT/mDeBERTa use0entailment/1neutral/2contradiction.
Use tokenizer(premise,hypothesis) native pair formatting; do not treat CLS or mean vectors as separately trained sentence embeddings.
No HF zero-shot pipeline binary entailment normalization for this control; record all3raw logits/probabilities and mapped label.
Freeze exact strings, field verbalizations, pair token budget, special-token accounting, truncation policy, label interpretation, and UNKNOWN policy before scores.
Preregister grammar-level entailment counterexamples and antonym/negation/conditional/composition strata independently of model output.
Optional separate explicitly declared control: compare entailment of both higher and lower hypotheses, with neither/both→UNKNOWN; this is a different arm, not a post-failure mapping repair.
Calibrate only on a disjoint calibration set; raw NLI softmax is not validated criterion confidence or a certificate.
